I found this among the remaining records of Eldoria.

It was kept with the writings of the elders.

Most of the pages were damaged beyond reading, but this one survived almost completely.

It was written near the end.

I do not know the name of the elder who wrote it.

There was no name left.

Before the record begins, there is one thing worth knowing about Eldoria.

They were scholars.

They studied everything.

Every battle.

Every discovery.

Every strange object brought back from the other kingdoms.

They collected records from every civilization they could reach.

They documented everything.

And yet...

even they were afraid of what Ashenreach had discovered.

THE ELDER'S RECORD

We knew.

Long before Ashenreach began searching for these powers, we knew they existed.

We had seen the signs.

We had found things that could not be explained.

For years, we kept our findings within the council.

We were afraid that if the other kingdoms learned of these powers, they would try to disturb them.

And we were right to be afraid.

Ashenreach has gone too far.

Their greed has brought them to something they do not understand.

They believe they have found power.

They do not know what they have found.

We have studied their records.

Their discoveries.

The objects they brought back.

Everything we could recover.

And the more we learned...

the worse it became.

There is something here far older than the kingdoms.

Something that does not seem to follow the rules we understand.

We cannot agree on what it is.

Some believe it can be understood.

Others believe it should be left alone.

Some believe we should destroy everything connected to it.

But there is one thing we all agree upon.
We should never have searched this far.

We began looking for answers.

We searched through everything.

Old ruins.

Forgotten places.

Ancient records.

Every piece of evidence we could find.

We thought that if we knew enough...

we could understand what Ashenreach had discovered.

But now I fear we made the same mistake.

We kept searching.

We found records older than Ashenreach.

Older than Eldoria.

Older than any kingdom known to us.

The same symbols appear throughout them.

At first, we believed they were simply marks left by an ancient people.

We were wrong.

They appear beside the same warnings.

Again.

And again.

And again.

We have found references to something beneath the ruins.

Something that was here before us.

Before them.

Before all of us.

I asked the council why nobody had recorded this before.

They had no answer.

Then we found another record.
It contained a single sentence.
DO NOT LET IT KNOW THAT YOU KNOW.

I thought it was a warning.

The others laughed.

They no longer are.

Something has changed.

The scholars are becoming afraid.

Some refuse to enter the lower archives.

Others claim they hear footsteps when the halls are empty.

Yesterday, I found one of the researchers staring at the wall.

I asked what he was doing.

He told me he was listening.

I asked what he could hear.

He said...

"Nothing."

Then he asked me why it was breathing.

I heard nothing.

I still hear nothing.

But I have moved my room.
I do not want to sleep near the archives anymore.

We continued our research.

That was our mistake.

We found the place.

It was beneath the oldest part of the ruins.

There was no door.

No entrance.

Only a staircase.

It had been buried deliberately.

We uncovered it.

I wish we had not.

The symbols were everywhere.

The same symbols from the old records.

The same symbols we found beneath Ashenreach.

At the bottom was a chamber.

Empty.

Almost.

There was something in the centre.

A mark carved into the floor.

We did not recognize it.

Then one of the scholars said something that made everyone stop.

He had seen the symbol before.

Not in a book.

Not on a ruin.

He had seen it...

in his dreams.

We have stopped searching.

The council has ordered the chamber sealed.

Three scholars have disappeared.

Nobody knows where they went.

Their rooms were untouched.

Their books were left open.

Their notes were still on the tables.

But they are gone.

We searched the kingdom.

Nothing.

Tonight, another scholar came to me.

He said he knows what happened to them.

I asked him how.

He would not answer.

He only said:

"It knows we are here."

I asked him what he meant.

He looked at me for a long time.

Then he asked me something.

"Did you see it?"

I told him no.

He smiled.

I do not know why.

We need to leave.

I can hear them outside.

They are saying something has changed.

The others are frightened.

Someone has opened the sealed chamber.

I did not do it.

The council says nobody did.

But the door is open.

There is something on the other side.

I cannot see it.

But I can hear—

Wait.

What is that?

No.

No, no...

I understand now.

It was never inside the chamber.

We were.

MY NOTES

That was the final part of the record.

The writing becomes almost impossible to read near the end.

The elders never finished their account.

I searched for them.

I found their laboratories.

Their books.

Their unfinished studies.

Everything they had spent years working on.

But I found no elders.

No bodies.

No explanation.

Nothing.

Only empty rooms.

And the chamber.

The entrance was sealed when I arrived.

I did not open it.

I did not even touch it.

Yet there was writing on the stone.

Fresh writing.
The same words appeared three times.
IT KNOWS.

I left immediately.

I have not returned.

There is something else I cannot explain.

The symbol I found beneath Ashenreach...

is here too.

I once believed Ashenreach had discovered something that caused the fall of the kingdoms.

Now I am beginning to think they merely found something that was already here.

And Eldoria...

Eldoria found out what it was.

Perhaps knowledge really does have a price.

Perhaps the elders paid it in full.

Or perhaps...

they are still somewhere beneath those ruins.
Waiting for someone to find them.
